sentences.en: It's important to take care of your mental health just like physical health.
sentences.zh: 照顾心理健康就像照顾身体健康一样重要。

sentences.en: The company offers counseling services to support employees' mental health.
sentences.zh: 公司提供咨询帮助员工维护心理健康。

sentences.en: She took a leave of absence from work to focus on her mental health issues.
sentences.zh: 她请假以便集中精力处理自己的心理问题。
